segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Yeah, sige. So may we ask the Chairman of Finance for his opening statement?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: We'd like to acknowledge Senate President Gatchalian and Senator Pangilinan as well.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And Senator Pia Quetano as well.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Thank you sa ating pong Vice Chair ng Committee on Finance, Senator Bam Aquino.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Magandang araw po sa lahat dito sa ating makasamahan, to my colleagues,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: to our Senate President, to our Minority Leader, and to my colleagues.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Muli, isang magandang araw po sa inyong lahat, especially to the DepEd family.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: To my colleague, to my schoolmate, and seatmate, former seatmate, Secretary Sani Angara.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Magandang umaga po sa inyong lahat.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: When we began our deliberations of the proposed 2027 National Budget, I called for return to basics,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: which means giving priority to the services that our people need most,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: and ensuring that every peso we allocate delivers meaningful results.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Sa edukasyon, malinaw ang ibig sabihin ng back to basics.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: May ligtas bang silid na paaralan?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Meron ang ating maanak? May sapat bang guro, aklat at kagamitan?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Nakakapasok ba silang busog at handang matuto?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: At higit sa lahat, natututo ba silang bumasa, umunawa, at magbilang?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: These are the basic questions that must guide our consideration of the Department of Education's proposed budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Para sa isang pamilyang nagsisikap maitawid ng araw-araw, malaking pag-asa ang edukasyon.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Umaasa ang mga magulang na sa bawat araw na mapapasok ang kaling anak na daragdagan ang kaalaman at kakayahan nitong bumuo sa mas magandang kinabukasan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Our deliberations must therefore examine both the adequacy of funding and the Department's capacity to deliver.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: We need clear answers on classroom construction, the timely delivery of textbooks and learning materials,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: and the feeling of teaching vacancies.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: We also need to understand how learning recovery interventions will reach the children who need them the most.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: But we should also recognize the progress that has been made.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: The Philippines' improved performance in the 2025 Program for International Student Assessment, or PISA,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: with gains in reading, mathematics, and science is an encouraging development.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Saludo tayo sa Department of Education.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Sa ating Secretary Angara, sa ating maguro at school leaders, at sa ating mga learners dahil sa tagumpay na ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Sa kabila ng mga hamon sa ating sistema na edukasyon, may pag-usad tayong nakikita.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Ngayon pa man, maraming pa tayong kailangan gawin at pagbutihin.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: In the past few days, since the Senate received the General Appropriations Bill,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: we've observed that the House version introduces steep adjustments to the proposed budget,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: basic education facilities, teacher development, and foreign-assisted projects.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: This morning, that's what we want to find out.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Kaya nga tayo nagkaroon ng budgeteering.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Of course, we would like to hear from Secretary Angara and the Department

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: ano po ang magiging epekto nitong mga pagbawas na ito sa ating programa, main program, sa ating DepEd.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Kaya nga po, kung kinakailangan talaga, ay gagawan nating paraan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: nung isang taon, we are quite proud that in spite of the floodgate scandal,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: the reforms that were started here in the Senate by then Finance Chair,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Senator Gatchal Yan, gave focus and priority to the Department of Education.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Kaya nga, ang ganda ho, tignan, that DepEd was at the center, talagang pinakamalaking budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Kaya nga, ang pagbawas ng 6 billion sa HGAB,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: We must understand what these changes mean on the ground,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: which schools and learners will be affected,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: which commitments can still be delivered,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: and where funding needs to be restored or increased,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: and what concrete results can DepEd commit to.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: When we recognize the scale of the task before DepEd,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: and the dedication of the teachers and persons who keep our schools running,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: sa huli, ang sukatan ng budget na ito ay makikita sa mismong karanasan,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: May mga guro bang gumagabay, may kagamitang nagagamit,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: may ligtas at maayos pang lugar para sa mag-aaral,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: at may kaalamang bang nagdadagdag sa bawat taon.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Every peso invested in education must help make that possible.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: With that, I yield the floor to our...

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: subcommittee chair, of course, one of our strongest advocates for education here in the Senate,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: subcommittee chair, Senator Bam Aquino, to lead today's proceedings.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And then we'll have Senator Cayetano.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, I just want to show three slides dahil 2026 ay naging napaka-importante

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: at maraming magagandang nangyari for 2026 in the education sector.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So first of all, nagkaroon po tayo ng isa sa pinakamataas na budget pagdating sa education sector,

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: about 1.3 trillion pesos or about 4.36% of GDP.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So ito ay pasok na pasok na doon sa requirement ng international standards na 4 to 6% of GDP allocated to education.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Pero alam ko marami rin challenges dahil isang...

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Isa sa pinakamalaking challenges dito ay yung absorptive capacity,

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: kung paano gastusin naman itong pondo na ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: At yan ang pag-uusapan natin ngayong araw na ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Alam ko binabantayan ho ng ating chairman of the basic education, si Senator Bam Aquino,

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: yung efficient na paggastos nitong budget na ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Pangalawa, and I have to congratulate the Department of Education under the leadership of Senator Sani Angara,

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: At napakalaking bagay ito, both for the education sector and also for national pride.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Dahil nung unang labas ng PISA, tayo pinakahuli.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So we also want to understand from the Department of Education, yung gains.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And of course, how to sustain the gains.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Sana tuloy-tuloy na ho ito pagdating ng mga susunod na panahon.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: On the local front, yung aral program through the aral law, malaki rin ang improvements pagdating sa literacy.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: 1.3 million students in grades 1 to 10 ang nag-improve.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Dati problema natin yung pagbabasa at pagbibilang ngayon ay dahil dito sa aral program,

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: ay malaki ang natulungan natin mga mag-aaral na magbasa sila at marunong magbilang.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So we also want to understand how we can sustain this program.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Naintindihan ko na hindi nabigyan ng pondo ito this 2027.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: At yun naman ang aming magiging commitment sa Department of Education.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Dahil kung maganda yung programa, dapat mapondohan para masustain yung gains nitong programa na ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So 2026 was a good year for the education sector.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Ang next challenge natin is paano natin masustain itong mga naumpisahan na natin through the 2027 budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So with that, I thank the Chairman of the Subcommittee on Education.

segments.speaker: Senator Alan Peter S. Cayetano
segments.text: Sir Chairman and Mr. Senate President, with your permission, may I yield because Senator Pia has another appointment.

segments.speaker: Senator Alan Peter S. Cayetano
segments.text: And since she formed part of my education, I will...

segments.speaker: Senator Alan Peter S. Cayetano
segments.text: I will pass first the privilege to...

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Our colleagues know we have some important visitors that I have to attend to.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: I just wanted to have the opportunity to greet our Secretary and the whole DepEd team.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: As you know, I defended the DepEd budget and all the attached agencies when the Secretary was our Chairman of the Committee on Finance.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So just very briefly, well, welcome.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: First of all, and of course, I always tie this into the SDGs, no?

segments.text: A lot of our health programs are implemented through the schools.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: There's so much to say about gender equality, but my biggest issue is how girls are most affected by teen pregnancies.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: They're not really affected by teen pregnancies.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: It's the girls who are affected by teen pregnancies.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So we've got to work harder on that.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And then SDG 8 on decent work and economic growth.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Of course, the foundation happens in basic education.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And I'll add SDG 11 on safe, resilient, and sustainable cities and communities.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: As we talk about safeties in the schools, this really affects the entire environment, the entire communities.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So I also want to emphasize...

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: On the importance of future-proofing our education, the Secretary and those colleagues of ours who've been around since 2019,

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: I've been harping on this for a long time.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So now, when I started talking about the future of education, having a futures-thinking mindset, it was kind of vague.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: But now that AI is here, I think it's more...

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: It's something easier for us to grasp.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And so the challenge is really how to use AI but not let it take over the lives of our children.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: I'm not here to lecture, but I'm here to listen on how we are engaging with this new development,

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: how we can maximize this as a tool for our teachers, for our tool for those who are working in terms of planning,

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: the supervisors, the principals, and so on and so forth.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And I also, again, again, since 2019, want to emphasize in as much as we want,

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: we obviously want to see our children reading well and doing math.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: The four Cs, critical thinking, creativity, collaboration, communications.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: I started speaking about this around 2019, but now with AI threatening to take over so many jobs,

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: it's more important than ever because that's where we now have to make use of this different skill set.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And then my last point is early childhood education.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: I'll ask more questions about it later.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Good morning, Mr. Chairman, fellow senators and our officials from the Department of Education.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: As we deliberate on the proposed 2027 budget of DepEd,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: I would like to emphasize three priorities that deserve our urgent attention.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: More classrooms, computers, and safer schools.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Una, kailangan nating patuloy na tugunan ang kakulangan sa ating mga silid-aralan.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Hindi po dapat patuloy na nagsisiksikan ang ating mga estudyante sa mga silid-aralan,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: o lumakad ng kilo-kilometro para makapasok lamang sa paaralan,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: o napipilitang mag-aral sa mga pasilidad na hindi naman angkop sa kanilang pangangailangan.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: We must prioritize classroom construction, especially in areas where shortages are most severe,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: so that every Filipino child has access to a decent learning environment.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: is the safety of our children inside school premises.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: The recent school shooting incidents in school grounds are a painful reminder

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: that schools must be places of learning, not places of fear.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Our children should never have to worry about their safety while pursuing their education.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Na makatitiyak po ang isang magulang na makakauwi lagi ng ligtas ang kanyang anak mula sa paaralan.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Ikatlo at panghuli, may mga mag-aaral po tayo, lalo na sa mga liblib na lugar,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: na hindi pa po nakakakita ng computer o hindi marunong kung pa paano gamitin ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: As our lives intertwine with cyberspace,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: our children, particularly in the barrios,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: should be introduced to the information superhighway and to the artificial intelligence or AI.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Kaya nais po natin malaman kung ano mga programa at pondo ang inilaan ng DepEd

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: at ating bigyan ng importansya para palakasin ang school security,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: improve emergency response, provide psychosocial support,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: and prevent violence within our schools and computer equipment in every classroom.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: As we review this budget, let us remember that education is not simply about building classrooms and hiring teachers.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: building a future for our children and ensuring that they are safe while doing so.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Because every peso we allocate must translate into better classrooms,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: better learning conditions, and safer schools for every Filipino child.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Thank you and I look forward to a productive budget hearing. Thank you, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So, 100% of provinces, 100% of cities, and 84% of municipalities are covered by the infrastructure.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So, as to the budget that you have very generously provided us, Your Honor, I am told it's now 91%, sorry.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Ang coverage of municipalities, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So, it's really what you have done, Your Honor, is really cover practically the whole country, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Sorry, can I be clear lang? 91% of municipalities have a new or have classroom construction already?

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Have partaken of either a new classroom or a repaired classroom or a Gabaldon building or a alternative learning center or an inclusive learning center.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So, yung budget na binigay niyo po sa amin, yan po ang na-cover niya.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, it's spread all throughout the country. It's not concentrated in one place. That's what it means.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Just to clarify, can we go a previous slide, Secretary?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, since the total here is already 65.4 billion, ibig po ba sabihin yan na meron ng MOA or nakalista na sa DPWH yung lahat ng pupondohan nating classroom based on the 2026 budget?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But the total here is already the allocation.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: About 4 billion will still be accounted for.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Because ang nangyayari ngayon, minsan nagkakaroon ng aberya dun sa local government, humihingi sila ng adjustment.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So, we're preparing a reserve for...

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Like a buffer for all of those.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But more or less, for 2026, na-identify na natin anong municipality, anong klase.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Anong facility, anong klase in classroom.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, we will end the year knowing specifically where these classrooms will be built.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And they are in process of being procured and built.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And timeline-wise, and I'll ask you si Clara later, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But for the LGU-led and the DepEd-led, our expectation is that these classrooms will be built by...

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Hindi natin masabi, Your Honor, because they're different types.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Yung mga requiring demolition, you're expecting at least a 2 to 3 year horizon for those.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Like yung learning continuity space, yun yung to respond to typhoons, et cetera.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Those were put up in maybe 1 to 2 months.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: But the more permanent structures, you're talking maybe 1 to 2 years minimum, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, hopefully, since nagsimula na naman ito, before the end of 2027, most of these will be built.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: I'm putting you on the spot, Secretary, para may commitment ka to everyone.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Or which Yusek ang nag-assure po sa inyo dyan?

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: But Yusek Ron is also involved.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: We'll go into this in two more.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: We'll go into detail during my portion.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But para lang maklaro, kasi honestly, we highlighted this in the 2026 budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: People are wondering nasa na ito, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, most of these have been...

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: All of these have been identified.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And therefore, it can create expectation already from our children and from their parents na pag sinabing naka-identify na, may matatayo nga.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Pero ang tanong na lang, kailan ito physically mabubuo?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Now, as you know, EDCOM is building a tracker for this.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: I hope DEPED can continue supporting that tracker para even yung completion ng mga classroom na ito,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: maging transparent rin sa ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Because some of these will be done in 170 days, 200 days.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Some of these will take more than 300 days.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, kung malinaw na at maging malinaw,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: at least klaro sa taong bayan, klaro sa amin,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Now, for the benefit of everyone listening also,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: the budget is good for two years, correct?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, the budget that we allocated for 2026 is still live in 2027.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And we would like, maybe by plenary,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: sana you could give us an assurance of what percentage of this will be completed by next year.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: I'm sure, medyo huli na patapos na po.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Hindi na po ito makakompleto this year.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: I think that's safe to say.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, by next year, ano yung schedule of completion?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And we're hoping, of course, that the majority, if not the greater majority of these classrooms will be finished by 2027.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: We'll come up with an estimate, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So, of course, ito po yung additional portion.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Ito na yung wish list portion.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Opo, opo, medyo malaki-laki po siya.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Sen. Gatchalian, Pangilinan, and Tulfo are here.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: ang una naming pinag-uusapan is how to bring this budget back to 4%.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: It's our shared goal na mabalik natin ito to 4%.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Of course, we know maraming competing interests po dito.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But we will do our best na mataas po natin ito.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Magandang layunin po yung 4% po talaga kasi yun talaga yung benchmark.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: It's the recommendation of UNESCO, actually.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So, medyo suntok sa buwan, ho.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: But ito po nga, 147.9 billion, including our attached agencies.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So, for learning recovery, the ARAL has not received any allocation.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So, we're asking for 15.6 billion, 1.9 billion.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: 1.09 billion is the honoraria for teaching overload.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: If the ARAL tutor is a teacher,

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: they will not be entitled to the additional compensation

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: they have to go do it over on top of the 6R required by the Magna Carta Law for teachers, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So, there is training for DepEd tutors of 1.75 billion.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: External tutors compensation, yung mga hindi naman DepEd teachers, 928 million.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: ARAL resources, kasi nagpiprint po tayo ng resources, 4.6 billion.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Learning recovery and remediation consultation, 6 billion.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Ito po yung mas malaking bagay pag pinakain po.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Mayroon natin at binigyan natin ng food allowance, yung mga teachers natin.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: And just a small amount or 94 million for program management, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: And then we have the Bayang Bumabasa Initiative, led by EDCOM, 50 million.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: And for personal improvement, we have 52.1 billion with the teachers, the PDOs.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: And all of this is the vision of our president na talagang yung mga teachers makapag-concentrate sa pagtuturo.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Kaya lahat ng school sana, mayroon tayong project development officer, mayroon tayong admin officer to sit.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: yung mga non-teaching-related tasks, sila na po ang gagawa.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Then we have benefits and personnel support, yung overtime pay,

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: terminal leave benefits, laptops for teachers and staff, teacher training.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: And for improving the learning environment, we have infrastructure for classrooms,

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: classroom repairs, last-mile school buildings, pursuant to the law you passed,

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: 50 Gabaldon restorations, pursuant to the Gabaldon law,

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: disaster preparedness, that I think we're really looking at that,

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: seeing how many disasters have hit us in the past few years.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Textbooks and instructional materials, ito po yung nirecommend ho ng EDCOM na

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: bawat bata merong workbook, merong textbook, bukod sa textbook, may workbook siya na pwede niyang sulatan

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: at pwede niyang iuwi at hindi na po ipapasa-pasa sana.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: And of course, we're asking for additional for security guards, for metal detectors,

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: for perimeter fences, Your Honor, which were not really included in the budget previously.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Ito po yung second page, learner support and well-being.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Sa feeding, there is an additional request for 16 billion pursuant to what you mentioned,

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: to have greater coverage ng Key Stage 1.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Then for the vouchers, there's an additional request for 3.5 billion.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: But in fairness to the House, they granted us the 1.9 billion pursuant to the bill that you have passed, Your Honor, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So various programs, learner support programs for sports, for the Palarong Pambansa,

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: for mental health and guidance counseling, totaling 13 billion.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Inclusive education, which EDCOM 2 has been forging.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Inclusive of special needs program, madrasa education, indigenous people's education, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: This is the PQF, the Philippine Qualifications Framework, which USEC-ALDAB has been leading and really advancing,

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: especially in terms of ASEAN and syncing with the world qualifications.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: And of course, the AI, you mentioned, it was mentioned by...

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: We have an e-care, the AI center, the education center for AI research, which is unfunded right now.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So we're asking for funds for that, among others.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: For our attached agencies also, meron din silang mga request.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So the NBDB or the Book Development Board is requesting an additional 186.5 million for readership promotion, policy development, book fairs, research and advocacy.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: And of course, we recall the Philippines was the featured country.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: The Frankfurt Book Fair, which really gave a higher profile to our publishers.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: And I think really, binuhayan talaga yung book industry natin.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So I think many of our book authors, animators, book publishers are really very excited about the future prospects.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: And sana ma-sustain natin ito, riding on the momentum generated by Chair Cherise during the...

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: And of course, supported by our senators, Senator Loren, Frankfurt Book Fair.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: The NCCT or the National Council for Children's Television, andito ko si Sir Luis, asking for 61.8 million for child-friendly, educational, and values-oriented TV content.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So ito po, siguro mahalaga ko ito, given the need to inculcate values going forward.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: National Museum of the Philippines, Director Barnes is here, and they're asking for an additional 255 million for digital transformation, public access, museum engagement, and component museums nationwide.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Meron po yung National Museum branches natin, so they'll need additional funding for that, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Our Philippine High School for the Arts, dito po si Sir Greg.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: For Campus Rehab, I visited it. It's such a beautiful structure, Mr. Chair, if you have a chance, sa Los Baños.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: It's a National Artist Lindy Locsin structures, but many are in disrepair, in a state of disrepair, kasi siguro they are 40, 50 years old, but really beautiful structures na huge potential na kung ma...

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: ma-repair po natin, and we can really inject, and of course, really produce many of our very talented artists in dance, painting, sculpture, etc., Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So they're asking for 161.5 million for rehab of the campus, largely.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: And we have our National Academy of Sports, which is supported by many of our senators under RA 11470, asking for an additional 580 million.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So they're asking for an additional 498 million for salaries, teacher education, and many other things.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So, I hope you get a chance to visit sa Tarlac.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Alam po ni... nabisita na po ni Senate President yan many times, and we're thankful for the support, and hoping it can be supported going forward.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Riding on the successes of our athletes in recent competitions.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: And finally, the Teacher Education Council, under... also created by the law of the Senate President, RA 11713.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So they're asking for an additional 498 million for salaries.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: education, and graduate scholarship, and regional hubs, which are mandates of the law.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Your Honor, Ili Jenny Hoxon is here with us.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So, yun na po ang ating presentation.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Salamat po sa ating mga mag-eating senator, Mr. President, Mr. Chair, sa inyong suporta.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: At alam namin, hindi madali ang inyong trabaho.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Pero umaasa ho kami at humihingi ng tulong sa inyo para sa 2027.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And thank you for your presentation.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, I will ask my questions, then we will have Senator Gatchalian, and then Senator Tulfo, then Senator Pangilinan.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, maybe we can use your slides, Secretary Angara.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, my first three areas are on the classroom, school safety, and the feeding program.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But you've clarified many things, so ano lang po ito, follow-up na lang ito, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Booth, can we go to the slides on...

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Maybe we can start with the classrooms.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: In the video, may naka-identify na 23,000 classrooms completed.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Or does this include the target of 18,950 from this year?

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: These are those which were completed as of October of this year, and began as early as 2022, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So, yung cut-off niya is when it was completed.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So, yung funding year niya is several years.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Could be 2022, could be 2023, could be 2024.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, 23,000 classrooms were built from 2022 to 2025?

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So, maaaring nag-start previously, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Because if you remember last year, remember in that hearing, Yusec Lara was there.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: We knew that the completed classrooms of 2025 was less than 200, right?

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: I think there's a long, really a long, I don't know what you call it, gestation or

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Construction period ho. Kasi from validation to bidding to completion, it's really 2 to 3 years for one classroom.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Okay. So, potentially, these were classrooms funded in 2020, 2019, 2018, no?

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Well, not really. I recall during the pandemic, wala ho tayong masyadong funding.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So, 2020, 2021, very minimal ang funding ho natin for classrooms.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: But maaaring could be even previous kasi natenga during the pandemic ho.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So, nag-continue na lang ho afterwards.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Because we were, we had the longest lockdown.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So, we were out of school. We were doing study from home for over 2 years.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And we didn't really build during that time, no?

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Wala po. Kasi nire-direct ho sa ayuda ho yung classroom funds that time.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Yusek Ron is here. Are these still the PPP schools? Or would you know, Yusek Ron?

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: No, I think the PPP schools, Your Honor, natapos na yung 2022.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: I think, but a lot of, maybe some. May konti na lang ho.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Pero yung last payments for the Aquino PPPs were 2022.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Okay. So, definitely not the PPP during the Aquino administration.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: There was some classroom construction done during the Duterte administration.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: This is possibly, possibly that, right?

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Yung iba ho. Mga maaaring na umpisa.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Pero na-complete na lang ho. It's really hard to track the,

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: because there's a different construction timeline for every area ho.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Okay. I'm only asking because we've always started with 165,000 classrooms.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But with the 23,000 completion, does that mean that we're lower by, we're now at 140,000?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Para we can also update our figures, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: O, sige. So, anyway, si Carol naman is here. I'm sure he's behind me, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Napifil ko yung presence. Nandiyan ba siya?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Maybe by the plenary secretary, we can drill down para even in our statements,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: we can clarify what the gap is at this point, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Yes, Yusek C., would you want to add anything to the discussion?

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: He's mentioning some classrooms even took five years, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Baka dati kasi nga pandemic, natenga yun ng pandemic.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Basta huwag nating ulitin yun, Secretary, na five years to yung pondong ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Dapat one year, gawa na talaga siya.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Okay. So, let me go back to the classrooms.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: May we see by the plenary,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: the plan for the 65 billion pesos from the DPWH and from the LGU-led and DEPED-led.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: We would like to see by the plenary, the list of the classrooms.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, we can also publish it, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And at least the, not just the mayors, but even the parents and the children,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: alam nila, meron ang expectation of where these classrooms will be built.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Yusek Lara, could you give us an update on the DPWH-led classrooms?

segments.speaker: DPWH OIC Undersecretary Lara Marisse I. Esquibil
segments.text: Good morning, Mr. Chair. Good morning, Secretary, and the Honorable Senators.

segments.speaker: DPWH OIC Undersecretary Lara Marisse I. Esquibil
segments.text: For the 6,000 classrooms for DPWH in the 2026 fund,

segments.speaker: DPWH OIC Undersecretary Lara Marisse I. Esquibil
DPWH OIC Undersecretary Lara Marisse I. Esquibil
segments.text: And then we're at post-qualification, finishing post-qualification,

segments.speaker: DPWH OIC Undersecretary Lara Marisse I. Esquibil
segments.text: and short of award or awarded for 1.87 billion, which is 533 classrooms.

segments.speaker: DPWH OIC Undersecretary Lara Marisse I. Esquibil
DPWH OIC Undersecretary Lara Marisse I. Esquibil
segments.text: We've been encountering quite a few failure of biddings.

segments.speaker: DPWH OIC Undersecretary Lara Marisse I. Esquibil
segments.text: They've been concerned with the costing of classrooms with fuel price increases.

segments.speaker: DPWH OIC Undersecretary Lara Marisse I. Esquibil
segments.text: So, they were a bit market-sounding, gave us some feedback that it was quite low,

segments.speaker: DPWH OIC Undersecretary Lara Marisse I. Esquibil
segments.text: but we're repackaging it to be more attractive to prospective bidders.

segments.speaker: DPWH OIC Undersecretary Lara Marisse I. Esquibil
segments.text: We always just repackage it in order to minimize, extend spending on mobilization.

segments.speaker: DPWH OIC Undersecretary Lara Marisse I. Esquibil
segments.text: So, we cluster it in a better location.

segments.speaker: DPWH OIC Undersecretary Lara Marisse I. Esquibil
DPWH OIC Undersecretary Lara Marisse I. Esquibil
segments.text: But yes, we've been encountering, Senator, quite a few failure of biddings.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Is it correct, the MOA that you signed was worth about 20 billion pesos, right?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: ilan doon yung meron ng bidder at meron ng gagawa?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: At ilan doon yung di pa kayo nakakapaghanap ng bidder at gagawa?

segments.speaker: DPWH OIC Undersecretary Lara Marisse I. Esquibil
DPWH OIC Undersecretary Lara Marisse I. Esquibil
segments.text: We have bidders, prospective bidders, well, already submitted bids.

segments.speaker: DPWH OIC Undersecretary Lara Marisse I. Esquibil
segments.text: And some are already NTP or short of award.

segments.speaker: DPWH OIC Undersecretary Lara Marisse I. Esquibil
DPWH OIC Undersecretary Lara Marisse I. Esquibil
segments.text: We've had attendees in our pre-bid conference, but still no assurance on if they will submit.

segments.speaker: DPWH OIC Undersecretary Lara Marisse I. Esquibil
Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Okay, but that's 1.8, is that correct?

segments.speaker: DPWH OIC Undersecretary Lara Marisse I. Esquibil
DPWH OIC Undersecretary Lara Marisse I. Esquibil
DPWH OIC Undersecretary Lara Marisse I. Esquibil
Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: That's a very low amount, ang baba niyan, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, kasi my understanding with the LGU-led is the MOA's are already there.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, yung natirang 40 plus billion na yan, meron ng identified yan ng mga LGUs?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And some of them, these are in different stages.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: May mga ilan, advanced na, meaning nag-groundbreaking na, kasi may nag-groundbreaking na yun akong napuntahan.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: May mga iba, nagba-back and forth pa dun sa final designs, no?

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: In fact, there's some under construction already.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Has there been any feedback with regard to failing bid?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Or difficulty in completion of the schools?

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Wala pa, pero kasi ina-anticipate nung ibang LGU and they ask for a cost adjustment, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So, we have a 10% ban na pagpasok dun, ginagrant na namin automatically because we acknowledge that, as mentioned by you, si Clara,

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: meron na iba na talaga yung presyo ng mga kagamitan.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Yes, in fact, in the last hearing that we had, I was surprised that your price was still that low

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: considering nag-Iran war na, nagtaas na yung presyo ng mga bansang.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, you've adjusted, but there are still no takers.

segments.speaker: DPWH OIC Undersecretary Lara Marisse I. Esquibil
DPWH OIC Undersecretary Lara Marisse I. Esquibil
segments.text: Actually, Senator, the 7 billion, we have prospective bidders, but still around 2 to 3 weeks of remaining procurement time.

segments.speaker: DPWH OIC Undersecretary Lara Marisse I. Esquibil
segments.text: So, 7B, some of these were already advertised again or advertised a second time, and we've already come up with prospective bidders.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: If by the, and I don't know, is there a DBM representative here?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Nag-moa na ho sila, pero kung hindi ito ma-fulfill, pwede pa bang ibalik yan sa DepEd?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Kunyari, hindi nila matapos by the end of the year, you si Clara.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Anyway, ikaw naman nagsabi, 1.7 out of 21.4 lang palang nabibid nila.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Pwede pa bang ibalik yun sa DepEd?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Kasi alam ko na transfer na to, di ba?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Ah, no, it's with DBM pa rin?

segments.speaker: DPWH OIC Undersecretary Lara Marisse I. Esquibil
segments.text: The funds transferred is only 7 billion.

segments.speaker: DPWH OIC Undersecretary Lara Marisse I. Esquibil
Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Okay, can I ask Director Vivian, pwede pa po ba yung, kasi remember we had a hearing,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: ang sabi natin at the end of the year, chicheck natin anong kabayo yung pinaka mabilis at efficient.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Or DepEd and LGU led ba ito?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Nandito na tayo sa end of the year.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Nakikita natin anong gumagalaw, anong di gumagalaw.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Is it still possible to allocate it in a different way, Director Vivian?

segments.speaker: DBM Budget and Management Bureau-F Director Vivien V. Labastilla
DBM Budget and Management Bureau-F Director Vivien V. Labastilla
segments.text: Yes po, since hindi pa naman natatransfer din yung cash.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Our plenary is end of November.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: If I'm not mistaken, November 24 or 25.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: End of the year na yun.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Di ba, end of the year na yun.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Kung wala pa rin talagang bidder,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: can we please consider that Seksani with Sek Vins and with Secretary Kim of DBM,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: can we still talk, can we consider that if that's another month from now, Yusek Lara?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Kasi kung di talaga yan gumagalaw, doon na tayo kung saan gagalaw.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: We will accede to what the committee wants.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: No, it's actually an executive already.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: It's not our call anymore, SP, di ba?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Hindi natin call ito kasi na-allocate na po natin ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: It's really an executive decision at this point.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But I hope we can have another update by the plenary, Secretary Sani.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: We'll probably ask Secretary Vins also during the plenary for DPWH.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Parang 5% pa lang yung napapabid out ninyo.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: 8%? Okay, 8% pa lang napapabid out ninyo.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Doon natin siya ilagay sa kabayong.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Huwag na dun sa kabayong hindi gumagalaw, di ba?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And I hope you can discuss that.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Just a qualification on what we've said, Mr. Chair, with your permission.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: I was told by our Yusek for Finance that yung transfer na 7B,

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: hindi na po pwedeng ibalik sa amin yung funds na yun.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Okay, so we're talking about the balance.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Pero yung 7, kasi nasa treasury na ho daw yun.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Ilang libo yung classroom pa yun?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Kung hindi talaga kaya, doon tayo sa gumagalaw, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Secretary Sani, so 8950, so the commitment of DPWH,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: the commitment of DPWH is 13,950 classrooms.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: We'll leave the 6,000 to DPWH, so 3950 is the commitment.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Ang tanong na lang kung magagawa ba ito by 2027 or 2028?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Okay, and correct to say that 97% of this, nasimulan na?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: We're in the process of finalizing the MOAs.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Yung iba nag-go back and forth pa.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So can we please, because by the way, pagdating ng plenary, I'm the one defending you.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So tatanungin rin ako nito eh, di ba?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So I hope we can have an update by November.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And to also support your chairman to defend this, please help us.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: I know that in the last few months, you've been really fast-tracking all of the MOAs, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Sana tuloy-tuloy po ito para pagdating ng November 24, kapag kaharap na natin yung buong Senado,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: we can really defend this budget, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So for 2027, we have 30 billion allocated for the classrooms, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And I take it that this will move faster than 2026.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Well, I think we still have time to do.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So if we have certainty as to the number, if we know it's not going to go down anymore,

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: But we did that in 2025, Your Honor, and the number changed at the BICAM.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So nasira ho yung early procurement activities namin.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Because hinati yung inalat for classrooms.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So the early procurement was for not, but that would have saved several months.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So by January, ma-award na sana yun.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Yung list of classrooms natin, I'm assuming naka-priority ito, di ba, by area.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So may mga hindi tayo na hahagit, di ba?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So meaning, kunyari, kung ang priority ng isang lugar, 50 classrooms,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: but they probably submit a list of 70 classrooms or even more.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So meaning, yung identification nitong next batch should be easier already

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: because we already have all the data.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Yes, and we have the validation.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: The validation is in a more advanced stage also, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: We don't revalidate every year naman, di ba?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: The validation that we did for this year is good for next year.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So the identification of these 30 billion should be faster also.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: There's a suggestion among the senators which we can take offline also.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: If we need to identify, considering we already have all the data

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: and all the submissions and as being former chairman of finance,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: you know that we also have all these folders, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Opsiya na yan, worth of folders at this point.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Would it be better, and maybe I can ask DBM also,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: would it be better to identify the areas

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: or would you suggest we still give it to DepEd to have that leeway?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: I understand kasi this year, ang laki ng allocation and it was a big jump,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: so it was almost impossible to identify it by December of 2025.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But for 2027, the data is there already.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Would it make sense to identify the 30 billion?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Or would you suggest to just keep it broad?

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Maybe not down to the school level, Your Honor, because in the past, that was done.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: But because of issues on the ground, whether legal questions or ownership issues,

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: may mga schools na hindi natuloy.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So then that money could no longer be transferred or used for other projects.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: That would make our life easier than we just follow.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: There is a cost to that and that is the inflexibility, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Yeah, so you're suggesting we just continue the process?

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Or provide what area should be prioritized, last mile schools or those with double and triple shifts, as you mentioned.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So we can include that in the...

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Maybe a general qualification that allows for a certain degree of flexibility, Your Honor, would make sense.

segments.speaker: DBM Budget and Management Bureau-F Director Vivien V. Labastilla
segments.text: Mr. Chair, yes, we respectfully agree.

segments.speaker: DBM Budget and Management Bureau-F Director Vivien V. Labastilla
Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Let's leave the classrooms for now.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Let's go to the feeding program.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: This is a LEDOC, as Secretary Sani knows and the Senate President knows, this is a LEDOC measure.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And the feeding program is probably one of our biggest contributions to decrease our learning gap.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Kung mapondohan po natin ito at ma-implement natin na maayos,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: many of our issues in our schools should be solved.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Or this will help in a big way yung mga problema po ng mga bata pag-ating sa pagtuto.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So may I ask, Secretary, or baka si Yusek Cabral might want to be the one to answer,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: the huge jump in the budget, sir, kayo yun diba? Kayo yun sa feeding program, right?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Ah, si Asik Roger pala yun.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Sorry, medyo magkalupalay kasi na konti.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Pwede kayong sumingit dito kung gusto nyo kay Yusek Ron, if you wish to answer.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: May I know, what were the biggest challenges?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Kasi ang laki po ng jump ng pondo in 2026 sa feeding program.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Were you able to properly absorb it, distribute the nutritious food?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Kasi ako, personally, sasabihin ko right now, intention ko talaga to really push for the increase.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: the Expanded National Nutrition Program or yung Librim Pagkain para sa Batang Pilipino Act in the works.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Nasa BICAM stage na po ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, could you help us, Asik Roger?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Yung naging malaking talon sa pondo ngayong taon,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: were you able to successfully implement the feeding program as stated in the GAA?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Kasi sa GAA po, Universal K, Universal Grade 1 at 23 pesos.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Were we able to implement that this year?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: I see that we have gains eh, diba?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, I'm sure there's a level of implementation we were able to do.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But, could you help us, Asik Roger?

segments.speaker: DepEd Assistant Secretary Roger B. Masapol
segments.text: Yes po. Good morning po, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DepEd Assistant Secretary Roger B. Masapol
DepEd Assistant Secretary Roger B. Masapol
segments.text: Tapos, ang kaibahan po ngayon is that nasa division office na po yung pera.

segments.speaker: DepEd Assistant Secretary Roger B. Masapol
segments.text: So, kung mayroon tayong 220 na kabayo, lahat na po ito tumatakbo ngayon.

segments.speaker: DepEd Assistant Secretary Roger B. Masapol
segments.text: So, lahat na po ng division ay nag-iimplementa po.

segments.speaker: DepEd Assistant Secretary Roger B. Masapol
DepEd Assistant Secretary Roger B. Masapol
segments.text: Pero, different po yung phasing nila.

segments.speaker: DepEd Assistant Secretary Roger B. Masapol
DepEd Assistant Secretary Roger B. Masapol
DepEd Assistant Secretary Roger B. Masapol
segments.text: Pero, lahat na po sila tumatakbo.

segments.speaker: DepEd Assistant Secretary Roger B. Masapol
segments.text: Yung difference po ngayon, Mr. Chair,

segments.speaker: DepEd Assistant Secretary Roger B. Masapol
segments.text: kasi mayroon, may ringgan mo kami ng 1 billion for the central kitchen.

segments.speaker: DepEd Assistant Secretary Roger B. Masapol
segments.text: So, ito po ay for ano na po?

segments.speaker: DepEd Assistant Secretary Roger B. Masapol
segments.text: For downloading na po yung pondo.

segments.speaker: DepEd Assistant Secretary Roger B. Masapol
