segments.text: So, yung issue natin na isa ay bullying.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: So, looking at the model of the anti-OSAEC classroom-based education,

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: Again, together with the Learner Rights and Protection Division, we've developed anti-bullying classroom-based sessions.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: So, ang kagandahan, it was developed in consultation with learners and personnel themselves.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: So, siya po ay kade-develop lang this year and hopefully it will be deployed in time for the National Children's Month of 2026.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: So, min-mirror niya yung same strategy at yun nga, tulad ng nabang ito, very consultative yung development.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: Nag-de-develop din po kami with the Learner Rights and Protection Division ng isang companion app, learning app,

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: na pwedeng i-leverage yung technology to teach bullying prevention knowledge to children.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: Tapos nakikita natin kanina yung power ng peer-to-peer approach.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: So, the way Stairway works with DepEd is that we take our local implementation experience, which...

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: is evidence-based, and then scale it up with DepEd

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: para mas makarating sa mas maraming learners.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: Kasi if we are looking at these various child protection problems

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: as a national problem, the solution should also be national in scope.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: pero marami naging schools yung merong gaps in capacity

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: in terms of anong materials yung gagamitin ko.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: And this is where these interventions come in.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: So for example, this peer educators program na ginagawa namin,

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: it's being implemented in our home base in Puerto Galera

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: and discusses these different topics wherein, next slide,

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: ang nagde-deliver ay mga peer educators themselves.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: So nakita namin yung kapangyarihan na kapag yung message ay nanggagaling sa kapwa bata

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: mas mataas yung learning retention in terms of these safety messages.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: And now last but not the least,

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: yung isang magandang framing sa child protection program ng DEPED is,

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: yun nga, yung nabanggit ng sekretary kanina,

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: yung kaagapay program was originally for academic nature,

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: pero dahil nga sa nangyaring spate of school violence,

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: na-transform siya to be more of a, dun sa child protection yung framing.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: So ang ginawa po namin with DEPED is to develop what we call

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: the Kaagapay Parenting in the Digital Age,

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: kung saan nare-recognize natin na marami doon sa mga violence cases,

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: na-disrupt sana natin kung nagkaroon ng early detection,

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: kung si parent na-detect na niya, teka lang may pinagdadaan yung anak ko,

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: and nag-access siya ng help sa school, for example, sa advisor, sa school guidance counselor,

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: na may napapansin po ka sana ako, baka pwedeng pagtulungan natin.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: So what we did was we developed a very simple session guide and session deck,

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: tapos nagkaroon ngayon ng series of rollouts sa regional levels at magkakaroon ng cascading training.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: In fact, nagkaroon ng dalawang Kaagapay Parenting Roadshow sa Cainta Rizal and Santiago Isabela,

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: at napakaganda ng feedback ng parents.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: So ano po yung tinuturo sa Kaagapay?

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: Number one, yung tinatawag namin na four C's of online risks.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: Mahirap gabaya ng mga parents yung anak nila kung hindi nila naintindihan,

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: ano yung mga iba't-ibang online risks na maaaring kaharapin ng mga anak nila.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: Pangalawa, ano yung mga online parenting and reporting tools, ano yung options nila?

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: At for us, yung pinaka-importante yung huli, yung parenting strategies.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: So ito po yung, kumusta, kasama ka, sundo ka, Kaagapay?

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: So basically, ang tinuturo sa parents, next click po,

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: sa kumusta, pinapaunawa sa mga parents na importante yung pangumusta sa araw-araw na buhay,

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: na pag-uwi mo ng bahay, hindi mo lang kakamusta yung anak mo tungkol sa kamusta ang exam mo,

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: kamusta yung test, et cetera, kundi may nagpasaya ba sa'yo ngayong araw, may nagpalungkot ba sa'yo?

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: At yung paraan ng pagtatunong ay napaka-importante.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: Kapag nagkapag-establish mo agad ng rapport,

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: kailangan maintindihan ng parents yung ginagalawa na online ng mundo ng anak.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: So dito tinuturo sa parents, ano yung strategy na,

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: paano mo maintindihan yung kinagigiliwa ng anak mo na online games?

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: May isang parent during our session, nag-share siya at narinig na ibang parents.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: Para maintindihan ko, nag-create ako ng Roblox account at kaming dalawa,

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: naglalaro kami ng anak ko magkasama.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: Ito yung paglalatag ng online safety family agreements.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: Importante sa mga pamilya na mayroong hangganan and boundaries.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: In terms of digital usage, digital lives ng mga bata.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: Halimbawa, pag sa hapagkainan, wala muna tayong gadget use.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: Kaya lang, sinasabi rin namin sa mga parents, kung mag-i-employ tayo ng ganitong agreement,

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: dapat kayo rin bilang parent, huwag kayong gagamit ng cellphone habang nasa hapagkainan.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: And last but not the least is yung kaagapay concept.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: Na kung saan tinuturo namin sa mga parents na kapag may nag-disclose na anak,

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: dapat ganito yung paraan ng paghahandol ng disclosure.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: At very importantly, i-access mo yung support system sa paaralan.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: So dito po yung framing noong kaagapay, parenting in the digital age.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: So kung titignan nyo, ang concept ay parenting in the digital age, hindi digital parenting.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: Kasi never mas magiging expert ang magulang sa anak sa technology.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: Pero may mga parenting skills na kahit hindi teki yung magulang,

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: pag in-apply niya sa anak niya, mas magagabayin yung anak niya sa online world.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: Pero ito po yung pinaka ilan sa intervention and partnerships na pinwede aside from others.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: With the indulgence of Senator Joel, sorry I was expecting a short presentation.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Maraming maraming salamat po sa inyong...

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: yung naibahagi, yung mga skwilahan natin dapat talaga ligtas.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And gaya na nasabi ko kanina, merong kailangan na pagpondo sa kagamitan.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And this is something we will work on.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Pero sa kaduluduluan ng lahat, ang laki ng responsibilidad at ng roles ng mga teacher, magulang at mga bata.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Nung nakwento mo na after the OSAEC module,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: merong 4,000 na bata ang nagsabi na they were at risk.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: I'm hoping that habang niloroll out ninyo yung modules pagating sa karahasan,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: ay marami rin mga bata ang magsasabi na kailangan nila ng tulong para hindi sila tumuloy sa karahasan.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: If you look at the School Safety Act, malaking focus po doon yung mandatory...

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: We call it a mandatory seminar for parents.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Pero parang ganito na rin yun.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Mas maalam yung mga magulang pagating sa ano yung nararanasan, ano yung kinalalagyan ng kanilang mga anak sa mundo ng online.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: I mean, after the Tacloban shooting, nung umuwi ako, so pumunta ako, nakiramay, nagtanong-tanong, pag uwi ko,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: the first thing I did, ginek ko yung iPad ng anak ko.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Kung yung parental controls, yung accounts, anong accounts yung...

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Yung naka-login siya, yung ibang accounts niya, accounts ko, so I had to check my accounts also on what platform she's on.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And honestly, yung mga nangyayaring karahasan, nakakatakot siya sa mga bata at sa mga guro,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: pero doble siguro yung takot ng mga magulang, honestly, sa nakikita natin.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, we're hoping that DepEd can really start this even before the law is passed.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But tama po yung isang nabanggit niyo, Mr. Dilo, yung scale.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Kasi maraming NGO, maraming grupong gustong tumulong, but only the DepEd infrastructure can really create the scale.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, this is a big challenge.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: 23 million learners, kung yung magulang times two, that's 50 million people that we have to reach out to,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: para malaman nila yung mga tamang patakaran pagating dito.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And again, I think we should be...

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: If somebody exhibits upstanding behavior, either magsumbong or magsabi, magkwento, kung sila man yan, o kaibigan nila, o kapatid nila,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: that should be seen as a positive that we're able to create that culture where our students, the teachers, and the parents can safely talk about these problems,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: and bring it up to the proper authorities.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Yes, last point po, before I go back to Senator Joel.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: This is my first time to sit in a budget deliberation.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: Napansin ko lang, bilang outsider, naslash yung child protection budget line ng DepEd from the original 80 million, naging 40 million lang right now.

segments.speaker: Stairway Foundation Child Protection Specialist Ysrael C. Diloy
segments.text: I'm just confused bakit bumaba ng gano'n, where in fact, child protection is one crucial issue we're facing right now.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Confusion lang ba ang salita, Senator Joel?

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: May dami na akong kasalanang nasabi dito, nandito na doon yung tatay ko, ayoko lang magsalita.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: We'd like to acknowledge Brother Eddie Villanueva who is here.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But that's exactly what we're looking at, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Baka naman po ay kung wala man siya dun sa item na yun, baka napailalim siya sa ibang mga items, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, Senator Joel, maybe a final...

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, I'm no longer gonna ask.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Anything, in fact, I can raise this through text message, Mr. Chairman.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: I just wanted to again congratulate the DepEd family headed by our brother, basketball teammate.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: I'd rather play basketball with him than ask him questions regarding the education situation of our country.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Mr. Chairman. Thank you, Secretary.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Ito ko nga, Senator Joel, maraming assist, walang block, di ba? Puro assist.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, we'd like to thank the DepEd family, Secretary Angara, and everyone for spending the last five hours with us.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: I hope to defend your budget well.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: I hope by the time we're talking about your budget, we can see the increases, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: In the very important parts that we've seen.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, maraming salamat po and see you at the plenary. Thank you.

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: I move, Mr. Chairman, that we approve on this level the budget of...

segments.speaker: Senator Joel Villanueva
segments.text: the Department of Education and its attached agencies for plenary action, Mr. Chairman.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Maraming salamat and we suspend this briefing. Thank you.
